raw_segments.text: and the pocketbook was again deliberately produced, opened, sought through. From one
of its compartments was extracted a shabby slip of paper, hastily torn off. I recognized
in its texture and its stains of ultramarine and lake and vermilion the ravished margin
of the portrait cover. He got up, held it close to my eyes, and I read, traced in Indian
ink in my own handwriting, the words Jane Eyre, the work doubtless of some moment of
